text_block_list.text: With the Japan Dirt Derby behind her, Smart Falcon focuses her attention on summer camp. Her passion is extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hnnngh! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Th-that's fifty… sets of sprints… done!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huff… Wheeze…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huff… It's okay! I can… keep going!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: There are going to be older students racing at the JBC Classic coming up!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That means I have to get even stronger during summer camp! So, Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I can keep going! Make me into a top Umadol!
She's been overexerting herself, though. I need something she can enjoy without putting too much stress on her body…
choice_data_list: Let's build that core with a dance lesson on the beach!
Exercise self-control! Let's have a dance lesson back in the lodge!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: A dance lesson! Like special Umadol training, right?
choice_data_list: Let's dance on the sand and improve your core.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All right! Let's dance!
Smart Falcon dances her heart out on the sand, her intense concentration captivating all those who lay eyes upon her, until…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Aahhhh…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: My… my legs are spent… I don't think I can move them another inch…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hold on, Trainer! I'm okay!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can stop now… I can't allow my feet to fail me now…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Get up, feet! Get up! And then…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Soar! Soar like a swan!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: …W-was I flying just now?!
choice_data_list: …You'll be the next prima ballerina, Falco!
…You'll be the next prima ballerina, Falco!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: What are they doing? Some kind of musical?
We may have gotten carried away, but in the end, Smart Falcon still enjoys a fun training session.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: A dance lesson! Like special Umadol training, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: But what do you mean by "self-control"?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Trainer! You're such a meanie!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Why, you! You can't just have ramen right in front of my face like this!
choice_data_list: Ahhh, nothing beats the rich flavor of seafood!
Ahhh, nothing beats the rich flavor of seafood!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Gulp! I-I want some too! Just a bite…
choice_data_list: Once you've done a whole concert's worth of dancing. Slurp, slurp…
Once you've done a whole concert's worth of dancing. Slurp, slurp…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Uggghhh! You're a monster!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: What's going on over there? Some kind of new game?
…After Smart Falcon manages to finish a concert's worth of dancing, I treat her to a bowl of special seafood ramen topped with clams.
